formation.note: No formal collaboration-founding date is published; 2002 is when a small group began developing the XENON10 prototype, which is the earliest dated origin found, not a stated founding date of "the XENON Collaboration" as such.
formation.quote: The development of the prototype detector XENON10 (operated 2006 - 2007) started in 2002 with a small group of scientists led by Professor Elena Aprile.

summary.plain: The international team of scientists that has built and run a series of ever-larger liquid xenon dark matter detectors at Gran Sasso in Italy: XENON10, XENON100, XENON1T and now XENONnT.
summary.technical: XENON Collaboration: about 200 scientists and students from 30 institutions across more than 25 countries (per the collaboration's own site, 2026), operating the XENON series of dual-phase xenon TPC dark matter experiments at LNGS Hall B since XENON10's development began in 2002 (XENON10 itself operated 2006-2007).
